## Projects

- [Multi-Agent Research Paper Writer](https://research-paper-agents.vercel.app/): LangGraph workflow of seven specialist agents that writes a cited research paper; citations verified against Crossref in code, human approval gates, Postgres checkpoints.
- [Multi-Agent Resume Optimizer](https://github.com/Prekshabarjatya/resume-intelligence-ai): LangGraph pipeline that validates, extracts and scores resumes against job descriptions with deterministic ATS checks and grounded LLM judgment.
- [AI Research Assistant](https://github.com/Prekshabarjatya/ai-research-assistant): FastAPI + LangChain RAG service that answers only from retrieved passages and cites them.
